notes.title: Bubble Surge Beta 1.4 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Bubble Surge Beta 1.4 Update Announcement:
	Bubble Surge Beta 1.4 version will be updated on May 9, 2025, which is the last major update before the official release of the game. The update content is as follows:
	New additions:
		-Timing system: Players can compare their game skills based on the clearance time, and the time only displays the current clearance time and the best time
		-End House: After completing the game, players unlock and enter the End House. The End House contains a list of game developers, clearance time, and displays of some iconic game objects
	In terms of levels:
		-Third level button fine-tuning
		-The monster's speed has slightly increased in the third level
		-Bug fix for restoring blue values to the ceiling in the third level
		-Shrinking the texture of archived objects reduces the probability of certain unknown bugs occurring
	Other aspects:
		-Fine tuning of textures on the Bubble Platform

notes.title: Bubble Surge Beta 1.3 Update Content
notes.notes:
Dream Sea Weeping Bubble Beta 1.3 Update Content:
[b] Level section: [/b]
-50% new content has been added to the first level, and the beginner tutorial section is longer
-The second level has added 40% new content and new gameplay
-The third level has added 35% new content and new gameplay
-While increasing playability, there is also a partial increase in difficulty
-After entering the portal in the third level, the setting for reincarnation was canceled
[b] Injury part: [/b]
-Added scalable monsters with high danger, but also have fatal weaknesses
-The magma damage is higher
[b] Skills section: [/b]
-Added bullet firing skill, bullets can trigger buttons and stun telescopic monsters for 5 seconds
-Added skill ball settings for each skill, and players need to collect the corresponding skill ball in order to obtain the skill
[b] Art section: [/b]
-Modified some bricks to make the texture more neat
[b] Music section: [/b]
-Three new pieces of music have been added, which will be played in levels two and three, and there will also be corresponding music for monster chasing
[b] Archive section: [/b]
-Added a save point in the middle of the level, where players can be resurrected after death, reducing the difficulty of the game
[b] Other parts: [/b]
-Partial bug fixes
-Player sphere collision box is smoother
-The video playback of entering the portal only retained one
